mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the two routes was most worthwhile: the arrows showed that one lap passes through the heart twice, once on the way to the lungs and once on the way to the body.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed attempt to connect the lung route directly to the left heart was confusing because their labels matched, but the body route had to be prepared first.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the matching lung-route and left-heart labels did not make an available combination yet.

arbitrary.text: That prerequisite felt arbitrary at first: the labels explained where the parts connected, but not why the left heart needed its body route before they could join.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: putting the routes together helped me understand the path, and I would be curious to see how another body system connects to it.
